effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may add your top security card to the hand. Then, if you have 2 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1＞ (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, you may play 1 card with [Gokuumon] in its text or the [SW] trait from your hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
